title: Too Nice to Tell the Truth: Quantifying Agreeableness-Driven Sycophancy in Role-Playing Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the tendency of language models to validate and agree with user opinions regardless of factual accuracy by administering 4,950 sycophancy-eliciting prompts across 33 topics to 275 simulated personas, and measuring the correlation between the models' sycophancy rates and the personas' agreeableness traits derived from the NEO-IPIP questionnaire.
